blurb:
Discover one of Miami’s most unique water experiences with this 2-stop guided adventure combining wildlife, scenic cruising, and sandbar relaxation.

Departing from Venetian Marina, cruise across Biscayne Bay with stunning views of the Miami skyline and chances to spot dolphins and manatees along the way.

At Raccoon Island, enjoy a hosted wildlife walk to observe the island’s famous raccoons and learn about their natural habitat. Then continue to the Haulover Sandbar, where you’ll have time to swim, float, and relax in clear, shallow water.
 • ✔ 2-stop experience: Raccoon Island walk + sandbar swim
 • ✔ Guided wildlife walk to observe raccoons in their natural habitat
 • ✔ 1-hour sandbar stop to swim, float, and relax
 • ✔ Scenic cruise with skyline views and marine life sightings
 • ✔ Hosted experience with a balance of nature and fun
